name: House of Tracks: Melodic House & Techno
_source: Checked 2026-10-30 against houseoftracks.com/page/upload-requirements and /page/upload-rules. Platform rules change: check them before each submission and edit this file.

format._note: Upload requirements: 44.1 or 48 kHz, 24 or 32 bit. The older upload-rules page allows 16-bit masters; the requirements page is stricter, so the bot follows it.

stems._count_note: HoT sets no minimum stem count, but kick, hats and snare/clap must each be their own stem. 10 is the Cryx standard.
stems._forbidden_note: HoT allows bus stems in the main stems folder, so BUS and GROUP are not forbidden here.

mix._note: HoT gives no headroom number for the mixdown: stems mixed but not mastered, master chain off. The bot only checks it isn't clipping.

null_test._note: Starting thresholds. Tune on the first real exports.

master._peak_note: Master limited between -2 dB and 0 dB on the master channel.
master._length_note: Track length 2:30 to 8:00. Master and stems are the longest version, never the radio version.

mixes._note: HoT wants the longest version; a radio version is an optional extra.

checklist: Three folders: master, stems, MIDI, plus an MP3 preview. Only .wav and .mid files inside: no project, no text files.
Master folder: the unmastered mixdown (the bot's Main.wav, master chain off) and the mastered WAV. With vocals: also both instrumentals (4 WAVs).
Every WAV the same length (except an extra radio version), and all from the longest version.
Kick, hats and snare/clap each in their own stem; a drum top loop can't replace them. No muted or empty stems.
Used FX on groups? Add the ungrouped single tracks in a separate folder inside stems.zip.
Stem names say only what's in them, in English (clap.wav, not clap.yourname.2019.wav).
One MIDI file per instrument (not one combined file), named like its stem. Transposer at the start of a chain? The MIDI shows the transposed notes.
100% original: no full melodic samples, no pack vocal chops or guitar loops, no templates, construction kits or pack MIDI.
Track info: genre, tags, name (no artist or label names), BPM, key, description, price, main instrument, vocal details.
